items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: We have trombone with us, sometimes Zoo Rob, you know Zoo?

ctx.x: Well, now, when you were all gathered there in the alley, would you be all clarinet players?
No, no, no, no. We have trombone with us, sometimes Zoo Rob, you know Zoo?
Oh, yeah. I knew him in California.
